title: Area Man Feels Joy Online for First Time in Years
gist: At WIRED World Fair, Onion CEO Ben Collins said Democrats' midterm wins could change the outcome of The Onion's stalled Infowars acquisition via a new Texas attorney general, and hinted at buying a Division 1 college bowl game. Despite the satirical headline, Collins called today's internet a 'joy vacuum', while comedian Patti Harrison argued the algorithmic version of social media, not social media itself, is the problem.

themes.theme: The Onion's Infowars acquisition and midterm politics

insights.claim: The Onion won Alex Jones' Infowars in a bankruptcy auction, but a federal judge in Texas struck down the deal and the legal battle is ongoing; CEO Ben Collins said the Democrats' midterm wins mean a new Texas attorney general might make a different decision.
insights.speaker: Manisha Krishnan
insights.so_what: Election outcomes can directly shift regulatory and legal outcomes for media M&A at the state level.
insights.quote: We have an attorney general in Texas who might make a different decision.
